// High reward for structural learning phases\n  }\n\n  // Step 2: Maintain persistent state variables (EMAs)\n  // We use the existing fast/slow glue EMAs as proxies and adjust them with the modifier.\n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n  \n  const double fast_ema = fast - modifier;\n  const double slow_ema = slow - modifier;\n\n  // Step 3: Calculate Performance Velocity V\n  // Positive V indicates degrading performance (fast \u003e slow)\n  double V = fast_ema - slow_ema;\n\n  // Step 4: Compute Forecasted Cost F\n  // Anticipates future performance based on current derivative\n  double F = fast_ema + (2.5 * V);\n\n  // Step 5: Calculate Dynamic Hysteresis H\n  // If performance is degrading (V \u003e 0), remove barrier (H=1.0)\n  // If performance is improving (V \u003c= 0), strengthen barrier (H=0.85)\n  double H = (V \u003e 0) ? 1.0 : 0.85;\n\n  // Decision: Switch mode (Restart) only if F_candidate \u003c H * F_current\n  // Here, we treat 'slow_ema' (baseline) as the candidate cost to return to,\n  // and 'F' as the current forecasted cost.\n  bool trigger = (slow_ema \u003c H * F);\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart check: V=%.2f F=%.2f H=%.2f slow=%.2f mod=%.1f -\u003e %s\",\n                            V, F, H, slow_ema, modifier, trigger ? \"YES\" : \"NO\");\n\n  return trigger;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP"}]},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","key":"req-0001"}
